name: One pass keep of retained layout nodes

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Text measure without a closure allocation

Mechanism: a kept or requested text leaf is measured through a `Measure::Text(inputs, log)` variant instead of a boxed closure, so no Box is allocated for it per frame. Allowed: taffy.rs NodeContext, fast/layout.rs text_context. Forbidden: when closures are set or cleared.
measurementPlanMarkdown: bm.sh e07 vs the E5 results over seven scenarios, 3 reps. Pass: allocations per frame down at least 20% on dashboard-clock with fast mode on, CPU not worse, layout/text/taffy/retained tests green, clippy clean.
reportMarkdown:
## Text measure without a closure allocation Finished

Passed: true. The measure closure of every kept text leaf was a Box allocated and freed each frame; as an enum variant it is two Rc clones. Allocations drop 13-80% with fast mode on; CPU gains 1-3% (inside noise individually, consistent in direction). Tests: layout (9), text (12), taffy (16), retained (16) pass; clippy clean.

Attempt Count: 1. Out-of-scope changes: removed the two helpers (`NodeContext::measuring`, `MeasuredLayoutKind::text`) nothing used.
